hypotheses.Q0_symmetric_tensor_matches_projected_na: The full contracted rank-128 tensor matches direct projected native CP execution to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q1_rank128_quotient_improves_over_rank64: Full-quotient fidelity exceeds rank-64 by at least 0.20 for every endpoint and corpus.
hypotheses.Q2_rank128_input_output_quotient_is_usef: The full rank-128 quotient retains at least 0.80 of every endpoint on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q3_sixtyfour_tensor_modes_are_useful: Sixty-four tensor modes retain at least 0.80 of every native endpoint on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q4_sixtyfour_modes_preserve_the_quotient: Sixty-four modes retain at least 0.95 within the rank-128 quotient on every endpoint and corpus.
hypotheses.Q5_symmetric_tensor_has_energy_rank64: The rank-128 contracted tensor has energy R90 at most 64.
hypotheses.Q6_rank128_tensor_transfers_ood: For every endpoint, rank-64 mode OOD fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb.
